assumption: EU MFN duty on apparel (HS61/62) if no GSP+
value: 12% (most lines; upper end for the two chapters)
source: EU Combined Nomenclature (Reg. (EEC) 2658/87, Annex I) conventional duty: 12% on most HS 61/62 lines, e.g. CN 6109 10 00 cotton T-shirts; a few lines are lower (about 6-8%). 12% confirmed for CN 6109 10 00 and 6205 20 00 on TARIC-based lookups (celna24.pl, 24 Oct 2026); the official TARIC and Access2Markets pages did not render. Under current GSP rules Bangladesh apparel would likely be graduated out of standard GSP (Annex VI point 2: 14.5% share threshold for sections S-11a/S-11b), so 12% is the likely rate without GSP+

Regulation (EU) No 978/2012, Art. 7(2), second subparagraph: for GSP sections S-11a and S-11b the cut is 20% (not the 3.5 pp used for other sensitive goods), so 0.8 x 12% = 9.6%. Unlikely to apply: Art. 8 and Annex VI point 2 suspend S-11a/S-11b preferences when a country's share of GSP imports in the section exceeds 14.5%, which Bangladesh would. GSP+ would mean 0%
